name: Fintak
shortDescription: A personal finance tracker built end-to-end in Flutter, with local-only data storage.
fullDescription: Fintak is a personal finance tracker covering full transaction CRUD, category-based budgeting, and statistical charts for spending trends. Firebase Auth handles sign-in only — every financial record stays on-device in SharedPreferences, with no Firestore dependency, so the app works fully offline and keeps sensitive data local.

name: Vault
shortDescription: An offline-only password manager with PIN/fingerprint login and offline backup recovery.
fullDescription: Vault stores passwords and other sensitive items fully offline, with no cloud sync anywhere in the stack. Login is by PIN or fingerprint, backed by Hive for encrypted local storage and flutter_keychain for key handling. A backup and recovery flow covers the case where a PIN is forgotten, without ever touching a server.

name: StormEye
shortDescription: A minimal weather app with city-specific, multi-day forecasts.
fullDescription: StormEye delivers city-specific weather data, including wind conditions and multi-day forecasts, through a minimal and smooth UI backed by a REST API and Dart's async/await.

name: ChatApp
shortDescription: A real-time messaging app backed by Firebase Firestore.
fullDescription: A real-time messaging application with user registration and login, syncing messages across devices through Firebase Firestore and Firebase Auth.

name: E-Shop
shortDescription: A scalable e-commerce app with a product catalog, cart, and authentication.
fullDescription: E-Shop covers product catalog browsing, cart functionality, and user authentication flows behind a responsive UI, built with clean architecture patterns and a Provider-driven state layer.

name: Habit Tracker
shortDescription: A habit-tracking app with streaks and local-only data.
fullDescription: Habit Tracker helps users manage daily habits with progress details and consistency streaks, backed by local data storage and a structured Provider state layer.

name: TelegramJavaBot
shortDescription: A Telegram bot built in Java.
fullDescription: An early Java project building a Telegram bot from scratch — handling the Bot API directly rather than through a higher-level framework, as a way into working with external APIs and webhooks.

name: TicTacToe
shortDescription: A classic Tic-Tac-Toe game built in Java.
fullDescription: A Java implementation of Tic-Tac-Toe — game state, win detection, and turn logic, built as a fundamentals exercise.

name: HangManJava
shortDescription: A Hangman word-guessing game built in Java.
fullDescription: A Java build of the classic Hangman game — word selection, guess tracking, and win/lose state, built as a fundamentals exercise.

name: BlackJack
shortDescription: A BlackJack card game built in Java.
fullDescription: A Java implementation of BlackJack — deck and card modeling, dealer logic, and scoring rules, built as a fundamentals exercise.

name: Quiz_app
shortDescription: A quiz application built in C++.
fullDescription: A C++ quiz application — question flow, scoring, and program structure, built as a fundamentals exercise outside the Flutter/Dart stack.
